description: Presidential Secretariat - Essential Public Service for the Purpose of the Community (Essential Public Service Act. No. 61 of 1979)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the President using powers under the Essential Public Services Act (No. 61 of 1979) to declare certain services as essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on the application of statutory powers and the declaration of services as essential, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters classification.
